title: Gloria (Sohier, Missa Vidi speciosam)
desc: Mathieu Sohier, Missa Vidi speciosam, Gloria, 1556. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
